# Outsource MedClaim

> Outsource MedClaim is a U.S.-based medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) company. We provide outsourced medical billing, CPT/ICD-10 coding, denial management, accounts receivable follow-up, credentialing, patient billing, and bilingual virtual medical assistants (VMA) for independent practices, specialty groups, and health systems across all 50 states.

Key facts:
- AAPC and AHIMA certified coders and billers
- 98.5%+ first-pass clean claim rate, denial rates reduced to 4% or below
- EHR/PM integrations include Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, NextGen, and most custom systems
- HIPAA and HITECH compliant; Business Associate Agreement (BAA) executed with every client
- Percentage-of-collections, flat-rate, and custom enterprise pricing models

## Specialty Billing Services

- [Family Medicine Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/family-medicine-billing): E/M coding accuracy, CCM/TCM billing, and preventive care billing for family medicine practices.
- [Pediatric Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/pediatric-billing): Well-child visit coding, immunization billing, and Medicaid/CHIP billing for pediatric practices.
- [Psychiatric Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/psychiatric-billing): Time-based psychotherapy coding, mental health parity compliance, and telepsychiatry billing.
- [Dental Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/dental-billing): CDT coding, dental insurance verification, and PPO/out-of-network billing optimization.
- [Optometry Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/optometry-billing): Vision plan vs. medical insurance billing, diagnostic imaging coding, and dual-payer AR management.
- [Wound Care Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/wound-care-billing): Depth-based debridement coding, skin substitute billing, and chronic wound documentation.
- [Infusion Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/infusion-billing): Time-based infusion coding, CMS infusion hierarchy rules, and J-code drug billing.
- [Ambulance Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/ambulance-billing): EMS transport coding (HCPCS A-codes), mileage billing, and Medicare ambulance fee schedule compliance.
- [Laboratory Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/laboratory-billing): Diagnostic, pathology, and molecular lab billing with LIS/EHR integration.
